d: When a young woman vanishes after stepping out to buy salad dressing, police try to provide answers to her fiancé and family.
A cloud of smoke leads two truckers to a shocking discovery  the smoldering remains of a teenage girl.
Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.
Paula Zahn explores a chilling crime mystery involving a murdered mother of five and speaks to the individuals directly involved in the case
When a beautiful young woman is murdered the evidence points detectives to a killer hiding in plain sight.
The investigation into Sandra Iverson's stabbing death goes cold until a police canine team uncovers a trail leading them to an unlikely young suspect.
A young marine comes home and finds his nine month pregnant wife savagely beaten in their bedroom. Was he an innocent victim or could he have been responsible for the terrible crime.
A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom.  A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.
